title: Model engineering and the advanced learning path
subtitle: Connect representation, uncertainty, serving, and experimentation to actual failures.
goal: Improve the model layer only after identifying the failure
intro: Representation quality, generated answers, and serving reliability need different interventions.
case: The right passage is retrieved but the answer repeatedly ignores a domain condition.
A controlled experiment compares prompt, model, and adaptation changes.
Changing embeddings cannot directly fix every synthesis error.
